data.name: Greater Counterspell
data.description: The spell warrior gains increased versatility when attempting to counteract enemy spellcasting.

raw_tokens.value: Spell Warrior Class Feature.Skald Class Feature.SpecialQuality.Supernatural
The spell warrior gains increased versatility when attempting to counteract enemy spellcasting.
When counterspelling, he can expend two skald spell slots of the same level or higher than the opponent's spell, regardless of the school of that spell.|PREVARLT:SkaldLVL,11
When counterspelling an opponent's spell, the spell warrior can expend one skald spell slot of the level of the spell being cast, regardless of the school of that spell.|PREVARGTEQ:SkaldLVL,11
The spell warrior gains Parry Spell as a bonus feat. The skald does not have to meet the prerequisites for this feat.|PREVARGTEQ:SkaldLVL,17
